trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction reschedule call for an already-qualified lead, not a fresh qualify-and-book call. The customer carries almost the entire call with an unprompted, emotionally loaded life update; the agent stays passive through the disclosure, then executes the reschedule cleanly and gets a locked day+time. The energy is mixed: it builds on the logistics (a real slot gets found and confirmed) but leaks on empathy and on a silent, unconfirmed switch from the customer's requested in-person visit to a phone appointment.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear from metadata; the observed outcome here is a clean booked appointment (Tuesday April 21 at 2:30) but with a material unresolved thread — the customer asked for someone to come meet her in person, and the agent silently defaulted to a phone appointment without ever confirming that change with her.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Tuesday, April 21) and time (2:30) are confirmed and a text follow-up is promised, meeting the booked threshold — though the channel was set as phone despite the customer's earlier in-person request.
